_help: Copy to config.json (install.py does it) and fill in. config.json is git-ignored, so your details never get committed.
channel_style: casual, unfiltered talking-head commentary; one idea per video

_notes.creator_name / creator_name_spoken: how the name appears in captions vs how the voice says it (initials read letter by letter: 'A J').
_notes.instagram_account: username without @; leave empty to skip Instagram posting (you get the files to post by hand).
_notes.voice: any edge-tts voice; list them with: .venv/Scripts/python -m edge_tts --list-voices
_notes.music: optional royalty-free track (e.g. from the YouTube Audio Library); empty for none.
_notes.auto_publish: false = Claude shows you the title and asks before every upload; true = posts without asking.
